speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: They are saying twenty are taken. I have it from the stair, not from the lane. Later than the frame.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then it is later, and it is heard. I did not see them taken.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Heard. Not seen. I am in this room. The street door is not barred. You have not asked me to bar it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I am not asking. The shutter is the bar I made. Twenty is the number they are saying. I will not improve it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twenty, heard later. That is enough to take upstairs. I am not going out again.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: And I am not. Good night to the number.
